memory_update.text: SAIL should remain on the AI identity-governance watchlist because AI-agent and machine-identity governance are direct node exposures, but later layers must verify standalone AI-agent module adoption and retention impact.

AVPT is a strong underfollowed candidate for AI-era SaaS data governance and resilience because it combines Microsoft/Google cloud governance, data protection, and explicit AI-agent monitoring features with mid-cap scale.

VRNS maps to the data-security and AI-system-control chokepoint; the main unresolved issue is whether Atlas and AI security create incremental ARR or are mostly narrative around the existing data-security platform.

Observability and security-exposure names such as DT, TENB, RPD, ESTC, and DDOG were not fully expanded in this pass due to the four-candidate limit; a follow-up Layer 1B pass should compare AI observability, exposure management, cloud permissions, and DSPM purity.
